name: opencodex-lite
description: Windows local AI aggregation gateway and web console

scripts.lint: uv run --locked ruff check && pnpm --dir frontend lint
scripts.lint:fix: uv run --locked ruff check --fix && pnpm --dir frontend lint:fix
scripts.format: uv run --locked ruff format && pnpm --dir frontend format
scripts.format:check: uv run --locked ruff format --check && pnpm --dir frontend format:check
